digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify workflow routing and documentation gates
propositions: Documentation-only changes must execute via a reduced Verify lane with documentation gates only, skipping the full OS/Python matrix, mutation, packaging, optionality, identity, eval, golden-path, and artifact jobs.

Path classification logic and allowlist must execute only from trusted origin/main; the classifier checks out the exact patchset as read-only data via HEAD^..HEAD and never imports/executes patchset-controlled code.

Classifier job failure must trigger fallback full-route jobs through always()+result conditions while still blocking Verified, preserving fail-closed semantics when classification is uncertain or errors.

Shared documentation gates must be extracted once into .github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml and invoked by both full and docs-only Verify jobs; inline copies must be removed and all gate-reading structural tests must migrate.

Docs-only route selection requires classifier success plus route=docs-only output; full route executes on classifier failure, non-allowlisted paths, Python/shell/workflow/dependency/test/config paths, or unreadable/empty/parentless diffs.

Post-merge verification must demonstrate genuine docs-only changes route correctly and complete in <5 min with <4 runner-minutes, and genuine non-doc changes execute the full suite with all gates passing.
